jen (PM): quick sync — we need a rollout plan for the adaptive-surge toggle for regional routing. goal: enable controlled A/B of routing policy + automated fallback when latency or cost spikes. want alignment on flags, canary slices, and abort criteria.
sanjay (Eng): sketched a flag hierarchy: feature.flag.routing.v2 -> env/reg/percent. prefer percent-by-region so we can ramp different geos independently. also add a force-fallback flag.
kevin (SRE): +1 on region percents. propose default canary = 0.5% global or 2% in small region. rollout windows only during low-traffic hours. we need an automated rollback if p50 latency > 150ms or error rate delta > 1.5x for 5m.
maria (Analytics): we can produce A/B metrics: p50/p95 latency, error rate, cost per 1k tokens, and user-facing quality regression score (from eval set). need the list of baselines. I'll wire dashboards.
jen (PM): sounds good. question: do we gate by cost SLO (per-customer)? some customers on Dedicated expect no sudden token-cost increases.
sanjay (Eng): we can add routing_policy.cost_safety boolean that prevents fallback to expensive variants. default off for experimenters. for Dedicated we set it on.
lee (Security): reminder: flags must be scoped so Private customers cannot be exposed to hosted-only fallbacks. enforce via policy: flag.available_to = [hosted, dedicated, private] per deployment.
kevin (SRE): ops checklist: smoke tests, synthetic traffic to validate routing, circuit-breaker threshold, and a gradual delay-add step to detect backlog buildup. also add a kill-switch tag the oncall can hit with one click.
sanjay (Eng): high-level rollout steps: 1) internal staging (100% traffic but small test cohort) 2) region-limited canary (2% in us-west) 3) multi-region 10% slices 4) A/B lift to 50% 5) full. Each step minimum observation 30m with automated gating.
maria (Analytics): propose the gating SQLs and alerts: p50 > baseline + 30ms for 10m -> warn; p95 > baseline + 100ms or error ratio > 1.2 -> fail. cost-per-1k increase > 15% -> fail.
jen (PM): launch criteria (draft): no fails in 2 consecutive 30m windows across metrics, rollout docs updated, customer-impact checklist signed, and runbook ready.
kevin (SRE): fallback policy: primary = route to previous routing-policy variant; secondary = route to quantized model variant; tertiary = degrade to lower-throughput config with rate-limit warnings. prefer automated fallback + manual override.
sanjay (Eng): implementation note: add a versioned 'compatibility matrix' so model variant routing is validated at deploy time. also log which fallback triggered for postmortem.
lee (Security): also log PII redaction and KMS usage when routing hits external endpoints.
jen (PM): decision items for next week: - owners for each rollout step - exact canary percentages per geo - gating thresholds finalization - playbook + oncall training. who can own the owner list?
maria (Analytics): I can own dashboards + gating SQLs.
kevin (SRE): ops will own smoke tests and kill-switch.
sanjay (Eng): eng will own flag implementation, compatibility matrix, and fallback wiring.
jen (PM): great. I'll draft the rollout doc and ping for reviews. tagging deploy-bot to start a staging deploy once doc ready. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: staging deployment queued: job/route-adaptive-surge-staging-1719991111, will post status in #eng-releases.
jen (PM): ok leaving action items in the doc. thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
